title: Homology of the canonical prescribed-resolution comparison
statement: Let A,B be abelian categories with bounded below derived categories [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories], with enough injectives in A. Let F:A\to B be additive, X in A, I an injective resolution of X [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and n a natural number. Set K=F(I), L its zero extension and e=canonicalResolutionDerivedIso F I [def-pc-canonical-resolution-derived-iso]. The ordinary homology of this specific e satisfies \theta_F \iota_F = H^n(e) \rho_L \epsilon_K, where \theta_F is the single-object derived homology comparison [lem-sp-derived-functor-single-identification], \iota_F is the prescribed-resolution comparison [lem-sp-derived-well-defined], \rho_L is quotient homology and \epsilon_K is extension homology. Composition is read left to right; every factor is expanded in the recorded Lean statement.

proof.text: Construct R = injectiveResolution X and a comparison φ : R.Hom I (identity X) using InjectiveResolution.desc. Pass to the extended complexes. Quotient comparison naturality and φ.ι′_comp_hom′ prove that the chosen augmentation followed by the localized comparison is resolutionAugmentationIso I.

Apply naturality of F.rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit to the comparison of resolutions and cancel its invertible components on injectives. Combined with the augmentation equality, this proves that the chosen rightDerivedFunctorPlusObjSingleFunctorIsoQ followed by the localized F-image of φ equals resolutionDerivedIso F I.

Use homologyFunctorObjQIso_hom_naturality and isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex_inv_naturality at φ over identity X. Expand homologyRightDerivedFunctorPlusObjSingleFunctorIso, cancel the prescribed-resolution inverse, then expand isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex and cancel the map-extension and extension homology inverses. This proves the local hcore without any new theorem or hole.

Expand canonicalResolutionDerivedIso and apply homologyFunctorObjQIso_hom_naturality to the map-extension isomorphism. Functoriality and associativity identify the local hcore expression with the original right-hand side. The argument applies unchanged at n = 0.

theorem resolution_homology_transport
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A]
    [EnoughInjectives A] {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B]
    [Abelian B] [HasDerivedCategory A]
    [HasDerivedCategory B] (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive]
    (X : A) (I : InjectiveResolution X) (n : ℕ) :
    (F.homologyRightDerivedFunctorPlusObjSingleFunctorIso X n).hom ≫
          (I.isoRightDerivedObj F n).hom =
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor B n).map (canonicalResolutionDerivedIso F I).hom ≫
          (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctorObjQIso
            ⟨((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex).extend
              ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat, 0, inferInstance⟩ n).hom ≫
          (((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex).extendHomologyIso
            ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (rfl : (n : ℤ) = n)).hom
